ns2:course.label: Double Bass
ns2:course.description: Instruction in double bass at the advanced undergraduate and graduate level. Music majors must register concurrently in MUS 250. 2 or 3 undergraduate hours. 2 or 4 graduate hours. May be repeated to a maximum of 12 hours. Prerequisite: Primarily for music majors; junior standing. Passing of an audition is required prior to initial registration in any applied music course as approved by the faculty of the appropriate applied music division.
